issue: बीतहिं जन्म देह सुध नाहीं: बीतहिं जन्म read as 'as his life passed'.
our reading: As his life went by he had no thought for his body.
alternatives: From his birth on (जन्म बीतते ही) he had no thought for his body.

issue: धरम हेतु सब कारज कीन्हों: the subject is not named (Bābā, or the son who saw him).
our reading: Left open with a passive: all the work was done for dharma's sake.
alternatives: The son did all the work for dharma (Bābā's instructions); or Bābā did it.

issue: सुखसंतोष लहै न मन में: read literally (they find no happiness) it contradicts the line's sense.
our reading: Their minds cannot contain their happiness and contentment (लहै न = is not held).
alternatives: A slip for लहैं नर मन में (such men find happiness and contentment in their minds).

issue: महावीर धर ध्यान पुनीता: महावीर as the poet's name (signature) or as Hanumān meditated on.
our reading: Mahāvīra (the poet), holding holy meditation, composed this song.
alternatives: Meditating on holy Mahāvīra (Hanumān), (the poet) composed this fine song of Gaṅgārāma.
